title: UFOs over nuclear bases every night of Travis Walton's disappearance
place_text: Loring, Wurtsmith, Minot, Malmstrom AFBs, United States

tellings.quote: And one of the stories people don't know that Travis was taken on November the 5th to the 10th. Every night that Travis was gone, there was a UFO over a nuclear missile or a nuclear weapon storage area in the United States.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, tells a little-known side of the story of Travis Walton, a man who says he was taken by a UFO and was missing from November 5 to 10, 1975. Cameron says that on every one of those nights, a UFO was seen over a nuclear missile site or nuclear weapons store somewhere in the United States, and he names Air Force bases such as Loring, Wurtsmith, Minot and Malmstrom. If true, it would tie one man's abduction story to a wider pattern of interest in American nuclear weapons.
